An F-Droid repository for my Android apps. Built from source, signed, and served straight from GitHub — no store review in the way.

@REPO_URL@?fingerprint=@FINGERPRINT@ Pasting the whole line pins the repository to this key, so the client verifies it for you. The plain URL @REPO_URL@ works too — then check the fingerprint by hand.

Adding it to F-Droid

  1. In the F-Droid client, open Settings → Repositories.
  2. Tap + and paste the URL above.
  3. Add it and refresh. If you pasted the plain URL, confirm the fingerprint first.

The apps below then install and update like anything else in F-Droid.

Other ways to install

Each app's GitHub releases carry the same APKs, one per CPU architecture — arm64-v8a suits any recent phone. Obtainium can track those release pages directly if you would rather not add a repository.

APKs here are the same signed files attached to each app's GitHub releases, so you can move between the two without reinstalling. The index itself is signed with a separate key, which is what the fingerprint above verifies. Sources: github.com/lbellows.
